message.__transform: "This Queue will report all open orders for the selected Facilities that are either late, or due to arrive within the next 7 days"

dataTransform.transform:
[
  edges.node~>|$|{
  
    "q": quantity.value & " " & quantity.unit.name,
    "rq": receivedQuantity.value & " " & receivedQuantity.unit.name,
    "pq": pendingQuantity.value & " " & pendingQuantity.unit.name,
    "bq": balanceQuantity.value & " " & balanceQuantity.unit.name,
    "po": purchaseOrder.number & "-" & number,
    "bc": expectedReceiptAt = $moment().endOf("day").format() ? "#ffae21" : 
                expectedReceiptAt > $moment().endOf("day").format() ? "#47ff00" : 
                expectedReceiptAt < $moment().endOf("day").format() ? "#ff5656"
  }|
]
